text:
Absolutely terrible experience. This clinic is nothing but a tourist scam.

I had a confirmed appointment at 2:00 PM and was only taken into the room at 2:10 PM. I clearly stated during the booking that I needed multiple fillings. Despite that, after 20 minutes and only ONE filling, the dentist suddenly stopped and told me I had to come back another day because two other patients were waiting and she would need another hour for my treatment.

Then I was told that appointments are only 30 minutes long and that my time was over — something that was never mentioned before.

The worst part:
At the shop window, prices are clearly advertised as 900–1100 THB per filling. I was also verbally told 900–1300 THB. In the end, I was charged 1500 THB for ONE filling, with no explanation at all.

This is pure tourist rip-off. Prices are misleading, communication is dishonest, and the organization is a mess. You always end up paying much more than what was agreed.

Avoid this place if you don’t want to be overcharged and treated like a walking wallet.

text:
First off, I had one of those childhood traumatic dentist experiences, So I am lil biased here.
🤕🦷👍😁😎
5stars!!!😄
First time a dental visit was fun, well, as fun as it could be.
I was refered by Trevor at "BP" and a second by local Thai I trust.

Why this place doesn't have a lot of reviews is baffling.

I had a molar that needed eviction,
The lil thai girls( both probably PHDs) were awesome and professional,  the mean looking lady at the counter turned out to be really sweet( don't let her fool you), even the view from the waiting area has it's charm.😉

There was this moment in the chair while staring up through the gap in the sheet placed over my face, surgical lights, needles, little hands, high pitched gibberish all around me,
I thought to myself...
Have I been abducted by cute aliens?
😆😆😆.
All seriousness, staff, office, and experience was pleasant,
Going back soon to tackle some other issues I've been avoiding.

If your reading this you're probably going though some stuff right now and not sure what to do...
Just get up and go here,,,
thank me later 👍
